openmap-collect.config.page.title: GeoSurvey Cartographer
openmap-collect.option.collector.desc: Typing an address here starts contributing.
openmap-collect.option.enabled.desc: Off by default. Typing an address above turns this on. Turn this off here, and the address stays. On, this mod posts each chunk it surveys to the collector address above. Each observation names the server, the dimension, the chunk position and the ground. Each observation also carries your Minecraft UUID. This mod signs each batch with your Mojang profile key. An observation carries no player name and no position. A client marked vanished in the tab list posts no ground. The mod drops that ground and does not send it later. Your own map still records it. A collector keeps every observation for ever, and offers no way to remove one. This switch does not put you on a live map. The switch below does that. This mod never asks the game server, and that server never knows.
openmap-collect.option.session_proof: prove this account to the collector
openmap-collect.option.session_proof.des: Off until you switch it on. Tell the collector who is holding this key. It can then accept position and roster beats it was refusing. That tells somebody else where you are.
openmap-collect.option.gate.desc: Every server: contribute from everywhere. Only the servers listed: contribute from those and nowhere else. Single-player worlds are surveyed on this machine and never contributed. The worldmap is kept either way.
openmap-collect.status.no_address: nothing is being sent: there is no collector address
openmap-collect.status.off: contributing is off; nothing is being sent
openmap-collect.status.not_an_address: that is not an http:// or https:// address
openmap-collect.status.gate_none: the list is empty, no servers are being updated
openmap-collect.status.gate_listed: contributing from %s; single-player worlds are surveyed here and not contributed
openmap-collect.status.cleartext: http and not on your network; readable on the way; Done will not store it; use https
openmap-collect.toast.approved_ports.tit: Approved servers now match the port you typed
openmap-collect.toast.approved_ports.bod: An entry with a port approves only that host and port. An entry with no port, or one naming 25565, approves that host on any port.
openmap-collect.toast.dropped_servers.ti: Some approved servers were not added
openmap-collect.toast.dropped_servers.bo: %s is not a server address this mod can read. Not approved. The rest of the list was saved.
